**Comment**
+1 to add due to specific obligation.

Discussed briefly at end of legal team call 2026-02-12.

@quantenzitrone has described the history of related license [`xkeyboard-config-Zinoviev`](https://spdx.org/licenses/xkeyboard-config-Zinoviev.html) at #2761.

The links from that issue appear to suggest that what SPDX currently calls `xkeyboard-config-Zinoviev` was essentially a mistake caused during the xkeyboard-config project's process of pulling licenses from their source code files into their COPYING file.

Given that, we'll plan to discuss next steps on the next legal team call in two weeks. I am currently inclined to move `xkeyboard-config-Zinoviev` to "deprecated" status on the license list and to add this one as a new license, but will try to take a closer look before the next call.
